items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: because individual, Fletcher was killing them

ctx.x: Was it the writing or the soloists or both?

A combined organization. Not individuals, because individual, Fletcher was killing them, but they had all them arrangements and all that stuff, and they was something. They played together and they were really something.

Of course, Fletcher had Don Redman and all these -- Rex and all, all them guys up there and they would tear you up, we'd say dig, but this band come in as a collective group and when they had them tight arrangements, they was something else, man. You better believe it.
